## Descomposición de la suma de cuadrados

<div style="font-size:23px; text-align:justify; line-height:1.3;">
La suma de cuadrados total se descompone en cuatro componentes:
</div>

<div class="block-definition fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
<div class="block-title" style="font-size:22px;">Identidad del ANOVA factorial</div>
<div class="block-body" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;">
$$
SC_T = SC_A + SC_B + SC_{AB} + SC_E
$$
</div>
</div>

<div style="font-size:18px; line-height:1.45; margin-top:8px;">
$$SC_A=bn\sum_{i=1}^a(\bar y_{i..}-\bar y_{...})^2 \qquad SC_B=an\sum_{j=1}^b(\bar y_{.j.}-\bar y_{...})^2$$
$$SC_{AB}=n\sum_{i=1}^a\sum_{j=1}^b(\bar y_{ij.}-\bar y_{i..}-\bar y_{.j.}+\bar y_{...})^2 \qquad SC_E=\sum_{i,j,k}(y_{ijk}-\bar y_{ij.})^2$$
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2"
style="background-color:#eef4fb; padding:10px; border-radius:12px; border-left:8px solid #1a3a6b; margin-top:6px; font-size:19px; text-align:center;">
$SC_A$ y $SC_B$: efectos principales. $SC_{AB}$: interacción. $SC_E$: error dentro de cada celda.
</div>
